official_statement_rationale: The recent surge in headline CPI inflation to 7.44 per cent, driven primarily by a sharp spike in food inflation to 11.51 per cent, poses a significant risk to the durability of the disinflationary path. While core inflation remains relatively contained at 4.90 per cent, the persistent nature of food price shocks, if left unaddressed, risks spilling over into generalized inflation expectations. Given the prevailing uncertainties regarding the monsoon and the need to align liquidity with our inflation target, I believe it is prudent to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent. Maintaining the stance of 'withdrawal of accommodation' is essential to manage the excess systemic liquidity of 120,000 crore and to ensure that monetary conditions remain consistent with bringing inflation back to the 4.00 per cent target while supporting the ongoing growth recovery.
